In detail

Press coverage of Vallcarca focuses almost entirely on chronic squatting (okupació) and antisystem groups concentrated around long-occupied buildings (Ateneu Popular, occupied ~16 years, evicted April 2026; La Fusteria). Residents describe unauthorized parties, noise and clashes with these groups. This is a social-conflict/property-occupation story rather than documented street crime against travellers, but gives parts of the barri a rundown, tense feel reported consistently through 2024-2026. Sources checked: El Debate, Dec 2024; Metròpoli Obert, Nov 2024/Feb 2025/Apr 2026.
